semiconductor_relevance: High — Agileo Automation provides essential control and connectivity solutions specifically designed for semiconductor equipment manufacturers.
summary: Agileo Automation specializes in software solutions that enhance the control and connectivity of semiconductor production machines. They support Original Equipment Manufacturers (OEMs) globally, facilitating the integration of equipment into manufacturing execution systems (MES) to streamline production processes.
capabilities: Agil'SECS-II library for SEMI standard communication
Integration of SEMI standards including SECS/GEM and GEM300
technical_expertise: Integration of production machines with IT systems

regional_presence.France: Founded in Poitiers, France, Agileo Automation serves a global customer base from this location.
